Bug_Title: SA: Nonsensical self computation involving a field (e.g., x & x) (SA_FIELD_SELF_COMPUTATION)
Bug_Details:
This method performs a nonsensical computation of a field with another
reference to the same field (e.g., x&x or x-x). Because of the nature
of the computation, this operation doesn't seem to make sense,
and may indicate a typo or a logic error. Double-check the computation.
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the showBug() method. It performs a bitwise AND operation on the 'value' field with itself, which is a nonsensical computation as the result will always be the same as the original value.
Trigger_Explanation: The bug is triggered by asserting that the result of the bitwise AND operation on the 'value' field with itself is not equal to the 'value' field itself. Since the result of the bitwise AND operation on a number with itself is the number itself, the test case will fail.
Bug_Trigger_Explanation: The test results confirm the presence of the bug. The test case created an object with a value of 5 and then performed a bitwise AND operation on the same field. The expected result was also 5, which is the same value that was input. This indicates that the operation is not performing any meaningful computation and may be a typo or a logic error, as described in the bug information.
